raw: We find it difficult to express the emotions with which Charlotte's soul was agitated during the whole of this time, whether in relation to her husband or to her unfortunate friend; although we are enabled, by our knowledge of her character, to understand their nature.

translation.en: We find it difficult to express the emotions that agitated Charlotte's soul during all this time, whether toward her husband or toward her unfortunate friend.
translation.kr: 그동안 샤를로테의 영혼을 뒤흔든 감정들을, 남편을 향한 것이든 그 불행한 벗을 향한 것이든, 말로 옮기기란 어려운 일이다.

translation.en: Though from what we know of her character we can understand their nature well enough.
translation.kr: 다만 우리가 아는 그 성품으로 미루어 그 감정이 어떠했을지는 충분히 헤아릴 수 있다.

raw: It is certain that she had formed a determination, by every means in her power to keep Werther at a distance; and, if she hesitated in her decision, it was from a sincere feeling of friendly pity, knowing how much it would cost him, indeed, that he would find it almost impossible to comply with her wishes. But various causes now urged her to be firm. Her husband preserved a strict silence about the whole matter; and she never made it a subject of conversation, feeling bound to prove to him by her conduct that her sentiments agreed with his.

translation.en: It is certain that she had resolved to keep Werther at a distance by every means in her power.
translation.kr: 그 사람이 할 수 있는 모든 방법으로 베르테르를 멀리하기로 마음먹었던 것은 분명하다.

translation.en: And if she hesitated in that decision, it was out of a sincere and friendly pity, knowing how much it would cost him — knowing indeed that he would find it almost impossible to comply with her wishes.
translation.kr: 그 결심을 두고 망설였다면, 그것은 진심 어린 벗의 연민 때문이었다. 그것이 그에게 얼마나 큰 값을 치르게 할지, 아니 제 뜻을 따르는 일이 그에게 거의 불가능하리라는 것을 알고 있었기 때문이다.

translation.en: But various causes now urged her to be firm.
translation.kr: 그러나 이제 여러 가지가 그 사람에게 단호하라고 재촉하고 있었다.

translation.en: Her husband kept a strict silence about the whole matter; and she never made it a subject of conversation, feeling bound to prove to him by her conduct that her feelings agreed with his.
translation.kr: 남편은 이 일에 대해 굳게 입을 다물고 있었다. 그래서 그 사람도 그것을 입에 올린 적이 없었으니, 제 마음이 남편과 같다는 것을 행동으로 보여야 한다고 여겼기 때문이다.

raw: The same day, which was the Sunday before Christmas, after Werther had written the last-mentioned letter to his friend, he came in the evening to Charlotte's house, and found her alone. She was busy preparing some little gifts for her brothers and sisters, which were to be distributed to them on Christmas Day. He began talking of the delight of the children, and of that age when the sudden appearance of the Christmas-tree, decorated with fruit and sweetmeats, and lighted up with wax candles, causes such transports of joy. "You shall have a gift too, if you behave well," said Charlotte, hiding her embarrassment under sweet smile. "And what do you call behaving well? What should I do, what can I do, my dear Charlotte?" said he. "Thursday night," she answered, "is Christmas Eve. The children are all to be here, and my father too: there is a present for each; do you come likewise, but do not come before that time." Werther started. "I desire you will not: it must be so," she continued. "I ask it of you as a favour, for my own peace and tranquillity. We cannot go on in this manner any longer." He turned away his face, walked hastily up and down the room, muttering indistinctly, "We cannot go on in this manner any longer!" Charlotte, seeing the violent agitation into which these words had thrown him, endeavoured to divert his thoughts by different questions, but in vain. "No, Charlotte!" he exclaimed; "I will never see you any more!" "And why so?" she answered. "We may—we must see each other again; only let it be with more discretion. Oh! why were you born with that excessive, that ungovernable passion for everything that is dear to you?" Then, taking his hand, she said, "I entreat of you to be more calm: your talents, your understanding, your genius, will furnish you with a thousand resources. Be a man, and conquer an unhappy attachment toward a creature who can do nothing but pity you." He bit his lips, and looked at her with a gloomy countenance. She continued to hold his hand. "Grant me but a moment's patience, Werther," she said. "Do you not see that you are deceiving yourself, that you are seeking your own destruction? Why must you love me, me only, who belong to another? I fear, I much fear, that it is only the impossibility of possessing me which makes your desire for me so strong." He drew back his hand, whilst he surveyed her with a wild and angry look. "'Tis well!" he exclaimed, "'tis very well! Did not Albert furnish you with this reflection? It is profound, a very profound remark." "A reflection that any one might easily make," she answered; "and is there not a woman in the whole world who is at liberty, and has the power to make you happy? Conquer yourself: look for such a being, and believe me when I say that you will certainly find her. I have long felt for you, and for us all: you have confined yourself too long within the limits of too narrow a circle. Conquer yourself; make an effort: a short journey will be of service to you. Seek and find an object worthy of your love; then return hither, and let us enjoy together all the happiness of the most perfect friendship."

translation.en: That same day — it was the Sunday before Christmas — after Werther had written the letter to his friend just quoted, he came in the evening to Charlotte's house and found her alone.
translation.kr: 바로 그날 — 성탄절 전 일요일이었다 — 앞에 옮긴 편지를 벗에게 쓰고 나서, 베르테르는 저녁에 샤를로테의 집에 들렀다가 그 사람이 혼자 있는 것을 보았다.

translation.en: She was busy preparing some little gifts for her brothers and sisters, to be given out on Christmas Day.
translation.kr: 성탄절에 동생들에게 나누어 줄 작은 선물들을 챙기느라 바빴다.

translation.en: He began talking of the delight of the children, and of that age when the sudden appearance of the Christmas tree, hung with fruit and sweets and lit with wax candles, brings on such transports of joy.
translation.kr: 그는 아이들의 기쁨에 대해, 그리고 과일과 사탕을 매달고 촛불을 밝힌 성탄나무가 불쑥 나타날 때 그토록 큰 환희에 빠지는 그 나이에 대해 이야기하기 시작했다.

translation.en: "You shall have a gift too, if you behave well," said Charlotte, hiding her embarrassment behind a sweet smile.
translation.kr: "얌전히 구시면 당신에게도 선물을 드리지요." 샤를로테가 고운 웃음 뒤로 당황함을 감추며 말했다.

translation.en: "And what do you call behaving well?"
translation.kr: "얌전히 군다는 것이 무엇입니까?"

translation.en: "What should I do, what can I do, my dear Charlotte?" he said.
translation.kr: "내가 무엇을 해야 하고 무엇을 할 수 있습니까, 사랑하는 샤를로테?" 그가 말했다.

translation.en: "Thursday night," she answered, "is Christmas Eve."
translation.kr: "목요일 밤이" 하고 그 사람이 답했다. "성탄 전야예요."

translation.en: "The children are all to be here, and my father too; there is a present for each of them. Come then as well — but do not come before."
translation.kr: "아이들이 다 올 것이고 아버지도 오실 거예요. 저마다 선물이 있지요. 그때 오세요 — 그러나 그 전에는 오지 마세요."

translation.en: Werther started.
translation.kr: 베르테르는 흠칫했다.

translation.en: "I want you not to," she went on. "It must be so."
translation.kr: "그러지 마시라는 거예요." 그 사람이 말을 이었다. "그래야만 해요."

translation.en: "I ask it of you as a favour, for my own peace and quiet."
translation.kr: "제 마음의 평온을 위해 부탁드리는 거예요."

translation.en: "We cannot go on like this any longer."
translation.kr: "우리는 이대로는 더 갈 수 없어요."

translation.en: He turned his face away and walked hastily up and down the room, muttering indistinctly, "We cannot go on like this any longer!"
translation.kr: 그는 얼굴을 돌리고 방 안을 성큼성큼 오가며 알아듣기 어렵게 중얼거렸다. "우리는 이대로는 더 갈 수 없다니!"

translation.en: Charlotte, seeing the violent agitation these words had thrown him into, tried to turn his thoughts with other questions, but in vain.
translation.kr: 샤를로테는 그 말이 그를 얼마나 격하게 흔들어 놓았는지 보고, 다른 이야기로 생각을 돌려 보려 했으나 헛일이었다.

translation.en: "No, Charlotte!" he exclaimed. "I will never see you again!"
translation.kr: "아닙니다, 샤를로테!" 그가 외쳤다. "나는 다시는 당신을 보지 않겠습니다!"

translation.en: "And why not?" she answered.
translation.kr: "어째서요?" 그 사람이 답했다.

translation.en: "We may — we must see each other again; only let it be with more discretion."
translation.kr: "우리는 다시 만날 수 있고, 또 만나야 해요. 다만 좀 더 조심스럽게요."

translation.en: "Oh, why were you born with that excessive, that ungovernable passion for everything dear to you?"
translation.kr: "아, 어찌하여 당신은 소중한 것마다 그토록 지나치고 다스릴 수 없는 열정을 품고 태어나셨나요?"

translation.en: Then, taking his hand, she said, "I beg you to be calmer. Your talents, your understanding, your genius will give you a thousand resources."
translation.kr: 그러고는 그의 손을 잡고 말했다. "부디 마음을 가라앉히세요. 당신의 재주와 이해력과 천분이 천 가지 길을 열어 줄 거예요."

translation.en: "Be a man, and conquer an unhappy attachment to a creature who can do nothing but pity you."
translation.kr: "사내답게 구시고, 당신을 가엾이 여기는 것밖에 못 하는 사람에 대한 그 불행한 애착을 이겨 내세요."

translation.en: He bit his lips and looked at her with a gloomy face.
translation.kr: 그는 입술을 깨물고 침울한 얼굴로 그 사람을 바라보았다.

translation.en: She went on holding his hand.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 그 손을 놓지 않고 있었다.

translation.en: "Grant me a moment's patience, Werther," she said.
translation.kr: "잠깐만 참아 주세요, 베르테르 씨." 그 사람이 말했다.

translation.en: "Do you not see that you are deceiving yourself, that you are seeking your own destruction?"
translation.kr: "당신이 스스로를 속이고 있다는 것이, 스스로 파멸을 구하고 있다는 것이 보이지 않으세요?"

translation.en: "Why must you love me — me only, who belong to another?"
translation.kr: "어찌하여 하필 저를 사랑하셔야 하나요 — 남의 사람인 저를?"

translation.en: "I fear, I greatly fear, that it is only the impossibility of possessing me that makes your desire for me so strong."
translation.kr: "저는 두렵습니다. 저를 가질 수 없다는 그 한 가지가 저를 향한 당신의 갈망을 그토록 크게 만드는 것이 아닐까 몹시 두렵습니다."

translation.en: He drew his hand back, looking at her with a wild and angry expression.
translation.kr: 그는 손을 빼고, 사납고 성난 눈으로 그 사람을 보았다.

translation.en: "That is well!" he exclaimed. "That is very well!"
translation.kr: "과연 그렇군요!" 그가 외쳤다. "참으로 그렇군요!"

translation.en: "Did Albert not furnish you with that reflection?"
translation.kr: "그 생각을 알베르트가 일러 준 것 아닙니까?"

translation.en: "It is profound — a very profound remark."
translation.kr: "깊이가 있습니다 — 아주 깊은 통찰이지요."

translation.en: "A reflection anyone might easily make," she answered. "And is there not one woman in the whole world who is free, and has it in her power to make you happy?"
translation.kr: "누구나 쉽게 떠올릴 수 있는 생각이에요." 그 사람이 답했다. "그리고 온 세상에 자유로운 몸으로 당신을 행복하게 해 줄 수 있는 여자가 하나도 없겠어요?"

translation.en: "Conquer yourself: look for such a woman, and believe me when I say you will certainly find her."
translation.kr: "자신을 이기세요. 그런 사람을 찾아보세요. 반드시 찾게 되리라는 제 말을 믿으세요."

translation.en: "I have long felt for you, and for all of us: you have shut yourself up too long inside too narrow a circle."
translation.kr: "저는 오래전부터 당신을 위해, 또 우리 모두를 위해 마음이 아팠어요. 당신은 너무 좁은 울타리 안에 너무 오래 스스로를 가두어 두셨어요."

translation.en: "Conquer yourself; make an effort. A short journey will do you good."
translation.kr: "자신을 이기세요. 힘을 내세요. 짧은 여행이 도움이 될 거예요."

translation.en: "Seek out an object worthy of your love, and find it; then come back here, and let us enjoy together all the happiness of the most perfect friendship."
translation.kr: "당신의 사랑을 받을 만한 사람을 찾아내세요. 그러고 나서 이곳으로 돌아오시면, 더없이 온전한 우정의 행복을 함께 누릴 수 있을 거예요."

raw: "This speech," replied Werther with a cold smile, "this speech should be printed, for the benefit of all teachers. My dear Charlotte, allow me but a short time longer, and all will be well." "But however, Werther," she added, "do not come again before Christmas." He was about to make some answer, when Albert came in. They saluted each other coldly, and with mutual embarrassment paced up and down the room. Werther made some common remarks; Albert did the same, and their conversation soon dropped. Albert asked his wife about some household matters; and, finding that his commissions were not executed, he used some expressions which, to Werther's ear, savoured of extreme harshness. He wished to go, but had not power to move; and in this situation he remained till eight o'clock, his uneasiness and discontent continually increasing. At length the cloth was laid for supper, and he took up his hat and stick. Albert invited him to remain; but Werther, fancying that he was merely paying a formal compliment, thanked him coldly, and left the house.

translation.en: "This speech," replied Werther with a cold smile, "this speech should be printed, for the benefit of all teachers."
translation.kr: "그 말씀은" 하고 베르테르가 차갑게 웃으며 답했다. "그 말씀은 활자로 찍어 온 세상 교사들에게 나누어 주어야겠군요."

translation.en: "My dear Charlotte, allow me only a little time longer, and all will be well."
translation.kr: "사랑하는 샤를로테, 조금만 더 시간을 주세요. 그러면 다 잘될 것입니다."

translation.en: "But all the same, Werther," she added, "do not come again before Christmas."
translation.kr: "그래도요, 베르테르 씨." 그 사람이 덧붙였다. "성탄절 전에는 오지 마세요."

translation.en: He was about to answer when Albert came in.
translation.kr: 그가 답하려는데 알베르트가 들어왔다.

translation.en: They greeted each other coldly, and paced up and down the room in mutual embarrassment.
translation.kr: 두 사람은 차갑게 인사를 나누고, 서로 거북해하며 방 안을 오갔다.

translation.en: Werther made some commonplace remarks; Albert did the same, and their conversation soon dropped.
translation.kr: 베르테르가 그저 그런 말을 몇 마디 하자 알베르트도 그러했고, 이야기는 곧 끊겼다.

translation.en: Albert asked his wife about some household matters; and finding that his errands had not been done, he used expressions that sounded to Werther extremely harsh.
translation.kr: 알베르트가 집안일을 두고 아내에게 무엇을 물었는데, 시킨 일이 되어 있지 않은 것을 알고는 베르테르의 귀에 몹시 모질게 들리는 말을 했다.

translation.en: He wanted to go, but had no power to move; and so he stayed until eight o'clock, his uneasiness and discontent steadily increasing.
translation.kr: 그는 가고 싶었지만 발이 떨어지지 않았다. 그래서 여덟 시까지 머물렀고, 그동안 불편함과 언짢음은 점점 더해 갔다.

translation.en: At length the cloth was laid for supper, and he took up his hat and stick.
translation.kr: 마침내 저녁상이 차려지자 그는 모자와 지팡이를 집어 들었다.

translation.en: Albert invited him to stay; but Werther, fancying it was only a formal compliment, thanked him coldly and left the house.
translation.kr: 알베르트가 더 있으라고 권했으나, 베르테르는 그저 인사치레라 여기고 차갑게 사양한 뒤 그 집을 나섰다.

raw: Werther returned home, took the candle from his servant, and retired to his room alone. He talked for some time with great earnestness to himself, wept aloud, walked in a state of great excitement through his chamber; till at length, without undressing, he threw himself on the bed, where he was found by his servant at eleven o'clock, when the latter ventured to enter the room, and take off his boots. Werther did not prevent him, but forbade him to come in the morning till he should ring.

translation.en: Werther came home, took the candle from his servant, and went up to his room alone.
translation.kr: 베르테르는 집에 돌아와 하인에게서 촛불을 받아 들고 혼자 제 방으로 올라갔다.

translation.en: For some time he talked to himself with great earnestness, wept aloud, and walked about his chamber in great agitation.
translation.kr: 한동안 아주 진지하게 혼잣말을 하고, 소리 내어 울고, 몹시 격해져서 방 안을 서성였다.

translation.en: At length, without undressing, he threw himself on the bed, where his servant found him at eleven o'clock, when he ventured in to take off his boots.
translation.kr: 마침내 옷도 벗지 않은 채 침대에 몸을 던졌는데, 열한 시에 하인이 조심스레 들어와 장화를 벗기려다 그 모습을 보았다.

translation.en: Werther did not stop him, but forbade him to come in the morning until he should ring.
translation.kr: 베르테르는 말리지 않았으나, 아침에는 제가 종을 울릴 때까지 들어오지 말라고 일렀다.

raw: On Monday morning, the 21st of December, he wrote to Charlotte the following letter, which was found, sealed, on his bureau after his death, and was given to her. I shall insert it in fragments; as it appears, from several circumstances, to have been written in that manner.

translation.en: On Monday morning, the twenty-first of December, he wrote Charlotte the following letter, which was found sealed on his desk after his death and given to her.
translation.kr: 십이월 이십일일 월요일 아침, 그는 샤를로테에게 다음의 편지를 썼다. 그가 죽은 뒤 책상 위에서 봉해진 채 발견되어 그 사람에게 전해진 것이다.

translation.en: I shall set it down in fragments, since from several signs it appears to have been written that way.
translation.kr: 여러 정황으로 보아 나누어 쓴 듯하므로, 나도 조각조각 옮겨 적는다.

raw: "It is all over, Charlotte: I am resolved to die! I make this declaration deliberately and coolly, without any romantic passion, on this morning of the day when I am to see you for the last time. At the moment you read these lines, O best of women, the cold grave will hold the inanimate remains of that restless and unhappy being who, in the last moments of his existence, knew no pleasure so great as that of conversing with you! I have passed a dreadful night or rather, let me say, a propitious one; for it has given me resolution, it has fixed my purpose. I am resolved to die. When I tore myself from you yesterday, my senses were in tumult and disorder; my heart was oppressed, hope and pleasure had fled from me for ever, and a petrifying cold had seized my wretched being. I could scarcely reach my room. I threw myself on my knees; and Heaven, for the last time, granted me the consolation of shedding tears. A thousand ideas, a thousand schemes, arose within my soul; till at length one last, fixed, final thought took possession of my heart. It was to die. I lay down to rest; and in the morning, in the quiet hour of awakening, the same determination was upon me. To die! It is not despair: it is conviction that I have filled up the measure of my sufferings, that I have reached my appointed term, and must sacrifice myself for thee. Yes, Charlotte, why should I not avow it? One of us three must die: it shall be Werther. O beloved Charlotte! this heart, excited by rage and fury, has often conceived the horrid idea of murdering your husband—you—myself! The lot is cast at length. And in the bright, quiet evenings of summer, when you sometimes wander toward the mountains, let your thoughts then turn to me: recollect how often you have watched me coming to meet you from the valley; then bend your eyes upon the churchyard which contains my grave, and, by the light of the setting sun, mark how the evening breeze waves the tall grass which grows above my tomb. I was calm when I began this letter, but the recollection of these scenes makes me weep like a child."

translation.en: "It is all over, Charlotte: I am resolved to die!"
translation.kr: "이제 다 끝났습니다, 샤를로테. 나는 죽기로 마음먹었습니다."

translation.en: "I make this declaration deliberately and coolly, with no romantic passion in it, on the morning of the day when I am to see you for the last time."
translation.kr: "당신을 마지막으로 볼 그날 아침에, 낭만적인 격정 없이 차분하고 냉정하게 이 말을 적습니다."

translation.en: "By the time you read these lines, O best of women, the cold grave will hold the lifeless remains of that restless and unhappy creature who, in the last moments of his life, knew no pleasure so great as talking with you."
translation.kr: "당신이 이 글을 읽을 때쯤이면, 아, 세상에서 가장 좋은 여인이여, 차가운 무덤이 그 몸 없는 유해를 안고 있을 것입니다. 삶의 마지막 순간까지 당신과 이야기하는 것보다 더 큰 기쁨을 알지 못했던, 그 안절부절못하고 불행한 사람의 유해를요."

translation.en: "I have passed a dreadful night — or rather, let me say, a fortunate one; for it has given me resolution, it has fixed my purpose."
translation.kr: "끔찍한 밤을 보냈습니다 — 아니, 다행한 밤이었다고 해야겠지요. 그 밤이 내게 결심을 주었고 내 뜻을 굳혀 주었으니까요."

translation.en: "I am resolved to die."
translation.kr: "나는 죽기로 마음먹었습니다."

translation.en: "When I tore myself away from you yesterday, my senses were in tumult and disorder; my heart was oppressed, hope and pleasure had fled from me for ever, and a petrifying cold had seized my wretched being."
translation.kr: "어제 당신에게서 몸을 떼어 냈을 때, 내 감각은 온통 뒤엉켜 있었습니다. 가슴은 짓눌리고, 희망도 기쁨도 영영 달아났으며, 돌처럼 굳게 하는 냉기가 이 비참한 존재를 사로잡았습니다."

translation.en: "I could scarcely reach my room."
translation.kr: "방까지 겨우 닿았습니다."

translation.en: "I threw myself on my knees; and Heaven, for the last time, granted me the consolation of tears."
translation.kr: "무릎을 꿇었고, 하늘은 마지막으로 내게 눈물의 위안을 허락해 주었습니다."

translation.en: "A thousand ideas, a thousand schemes rose in my soul, until at last one final, fixed thought took possession of my heart."
translation.kr: "천 가지 생각과 천 가지 계획이 영혼에서 일어났고, 마침내 마지막 하나의 붙박인 생각이 내 가슴을 차지했습니다."

translation.en: "It was to die."
translation.kr: "죽는다는 것이었습니다."

translation.en: "I lay down to rest; and in the morning, in the quiet hour of waking, the same determination was on me."
translation.kr: "자리에 누웠고, 아침에 고요히 깨어나는 시간에도 같은 결심이 그대로 있었습니다."

translation.en: "To die!"
translation.kr: "죽는다!"

translation.en: "It is not despair: it is the conviction that I have filled up the measure of my sufferings, that I have reached my appointed term, and must sacrifice myself for you."
translation.kr: "절망이 아닙니다. 내가 괴로움의 잔을 다 채웠다는 것, 내게 정해진 때에 이르렀다는 것, 그리고 당신을 위해 나를 바쳐야 한다는 확신입니다."

translation.en: "Yes, Charlotte, why should I not admit it?"
translation.kr: "그렇습니다, 샤를로테. 어찌 이것을 숨기겠습니까?"

translation.en: "One of us three must die: let it be Werther."
translation.kr: "우리 셋 가운데 하나는 죽어야 합니다. 그것이 베르테르이게 하십시오."

translation.en: "O beloved Charlotte, this heart, whipped up by rage and fury, has often conceived the horrid idea of murdering your husband — you — myself!"
translation.kr: "아, 사랑하는 샤를로테. 분노와 광기에 채찍질당한 이 가슴은, 당신 남편을 — 당신을 — 나 자신을 죽인다는 끔찍한 생각을 자주 품었습니다!"

translation.en: "The lot is cast at last."
translation.kr: "마침내 주사위는 던져졌습니다."

translation.en: "And in the bright, quiet evenings of summer, when you sometimes walk toward the mountains, let your thoughts turn to me."
translation.kr: "그리고 여름날의 밝고 고요한 저녁, 당신이 이따금 산 쪽으로 거닐 때면 나를 떠올려 주십시오."

translation.en: "Remember how often you have watched me coming up out of the valley to meet you; then turn your eyes to the churchyard that holds my grave, and by the light of the setting sun see how the evening breeze waves the tall grass above my tomb."
translation.kr: "내가 골짜기에서 올라와 당신을 맞으러 가는 것을 얼마나 자주 지켜보았는지 기억해 주십시오. 그리고 내 무덤이 있는 교회 뜰로 눈길을 돌려, 지는 햇빛 속에서 저녁 바람이 내 무덤 위 키 큰 풀을 어떻게 흔드는지 보아 주십시오."

translation.en: "I was calm when I began this letter, but the memory of these scenes makes me weep like a child."
translation.kr: "이 편지를 시작할 때는 차분했는데, 그 정경을 떠올리니 어린아이처럼 울게 되는군요."

raw: About ten in the morning, Werther called his servant, and, whilst he was dressing, told him that in a few days he intended to set out upon a journey, and bade him therefore lay his clothes in order, and prepare them for packing up, call in all his accounts, fetch home the books he had lent, and give two months' pay to the poor dependants who were accustomed to receive from him a weekly allowance.

translation.en: About ten in the morning Werther called his servant, and while he was dressing told him that in a few days he meant to set out on a journey.
translation.kr: 아침 열 시쯤 베르테르는 하인을 불러, 옷을 입으면서 며칠 뒤에 여행을 떠날 참이라고 일렀다.

translation.en: He therefore told him to lay his clothes in order and get them ready for packing, to call in all his accounts, to fetch home the books he had lent out, and to give two months' pay to the poor dependants who used to receive a weekly allowance from him.
translation.kr: 그러니 옷을 정리해 꾸릴 채비를 하고, 외상값을 다 받아들이고, 빌려준 책을 거두어 오고, 주마다 얼마씩 받아 가던 가난한 이들에게 두 달 치를 내주라고 했다.

raw: He breakfasted in his room, and then mounted his horse, and went to visit the steward, who, however, was not at home. He walked pensively in the garden, and seemed anxious to renew all the ideas that were most painful to him.

translation.en: He breakfasted in his room, and then mounted his horse and went to visit the steward, who was not at home.
translation.kr: 그는 방에서 아침을 먹고 말을 타고 집사를 찾아갔으나, 집에 없었다.

translation.en: He walked thoughtfully in the garden, and seemed anxious to go over again every idea that was most painful to him.
translation.kr: 그는 뜰을 생각에 잠겨 거닐며, 가장 아픈 생각들을 하나하나 다시 되짚고 싶어 하는 듯했다.

raw: The children did not suffer him to remain alone long. They followed him, skipping and dancing before him, and told him, that after to-morrow and tomorrow and one day more, they were to receive their Christmas gift from Charlotte; and they then recounted all the wonders of which they had formed ideas in their child imaginations. "Tomorrow and tomorrow," said he, "and one day more!" And he kissed them tenderly. He was going; but the younger boy stopped him, to whisper something in his ear. He told him that his elder brothers had written splendid New-Year's wishes so large! one for papa, and another for Albert and Charlotte, and one for Werther; and they were to be presented early in the morning, on New Year's Day. This quite overcame him. He made each of the children a present, mounted his horse, left his compliments for papa and mamma, and, with tears in his eyes, rode away from the place.

translation.en: The children did not let him stay alone for long.
translation.kr: 아이들은 그를 오래 혼자 두지 않았다.

translation.en: They followed him, skipping and dancing in front of him, and told him that after tomorrow, and tomorrow, and one day more, they would get their Christmas present from Charlotte.
translation.kr: 아이들은 그를 따라다니며 앞에서 뛰고 춤추면서, 내일 지나 또 내일 지나 하루만 더 있으면 샤를로테에게서 성탄 선물을 받는다고 일러 주었다.

translation.en: And then they recounted all the wonders their child imaginations had built up.
translation.kr: 그러고는 어린 상상으로 부풀려 놓은 온갖 신기한 것들을 죽 늘어놓았다.

translation.en: "Tomorrow and tomorrow," he said, "and one day more!"
translation.kr: "내일, 또 내일" 하고 그가 말했다. "그리고 하루만 더!"

translation.en: And he kissed them tenderly.
translation.kr: 그리고 아이들에게 다정하게 입을 맞추었다.

translation.en: He was going, but the younger boy stopped him to whisper something in his ear.
translation.kr: 가려는데 작은아이가 그를 붙들고 귀에 무엇인가 속삭였다.

translation.en: He told him that his elder brothers had written splendid New Year's wishes — so large! — one for papa, and another for Albert and Charlotte, and one for Werther.
translation.kr: 형들이 아주 멋진 새해 인사를 써 두었다는 것이었다 — 그것도 아주 크게! 하나는 아버지에게, 하나는 알베르트와 샤를로테에게, 하나는 베르테르에게.

translation.en: They were to be presented early in the morning on New Year's Day.
translation.kr: 새해 첫날 아침 일찍 그것을 드릴 참이라고 했다.

translation.en: This quite overcame him.
translation.kr: 그 말에 그는 아주 무너지고 말았다.

translation.en: He made each of the children a present, mounted his horse, left his compliments for papa and mamma, and rode away from the place with tears in his eyes.
translation.kr: 그는 아이들에게 하나씩 무엇을 쥐여 주고 말에 올라, 아버지와 어머니에게 인사를 전해 달라 이르고는 눈에 눈물을 담은 채 그곳을 떠났다.

raw: He returned home about five o'clock, ordered his servant to keep up his fire, desired him to pack his books and linen at the bottom of the trunk, and to place his coats at the top. He then appears to have made the following addition to the letter addressed to Charlotte:

translation.en: He came home about five o'clock, told his servant to keep the fire up, asked him to pack his books and linen at the bottom of the trunk and put his coats on top.
translation.kr: 다섯 시쯤 집에 돌아와 하인에게 불을 꺼뜨리지 말라 이르고, 책과 속옷은 궤 밑에 넣고 외투는 위에 얹으라고 했다.

translation.en: He then appears to have added the following to the letter addressed to Charlotte.
translation.kr: 그러고는 샤를로테에게 보내는 편지에 다음을 덧붙인 듯하다.

raw: "You do not expect me. You think I will obey you, and not visit you again till Christmas Eve. O Charlotte, today or never! On Christmas Eve you will hold this paper in your hand; you will tremble, and moisten it with your tears. I will—I must! Oh, how happy I feel to be determined!"

translation.en: "You are not expecting me."
translation.kr: "당신은 나를 기다리지 않겠지요."

translation.en: "You think I will obey you, and not visit you again until Christmas Eve."
translation.kr: "내가 당신 말을 따라 성탄 전야까지는 찾아가지 않으리라 여기시겠지요."

translation.en: "O Charlotte, today or never!"
translation.kr: "아, 샤를로테, 오늘이 아니면 영영입니다!"

translation.en: "On Christmas Eve you will hold this paper in your hand; you will tremble, and wet it with your tears."
translation.kr: "성탄 전야에 당신은 이 종이를 손에 들고 있을 것이며, 떨면서 눈물로 그것을 적시겠지요."

translation.en: "I will — I must!"
translation.kr: "나는 그리할 것입니다 — 그리해야만 합니다!"

translation.en: "Oh, how happy I feel now that I am determined!"
translation.kr: "아, 마음을 정하고 나니 얼마나 홀가분한지요!"

raw: In the meantime, Charlotte was in a pitiable state of mind. After her last conversation with Werther, she found how painful to herself it would be to decline his visits, and knew how severely he would suffer from their separation.

translation.en: Charlotte, meanwhile, was in a pitiable state of mind.
translation.kr: 한편 샤를로테는 딱하리만치 마음이 어지러웠다.

translation.en: After her last conversation with Werther she found how painful it would be to refuse his visits, and knew how badly he would suffer from their separation.
translation.kr: 베르테르와 마지막으로 이야기를 나눈 뒤, 그 사람은 그의 발길을 막는 것이 제게 얼마나 괴로운 일인지 알게 되었고, 헤어짐이 그에게 얼마나 큰 아픔이 될지도 알고 있었다.

raw: She had, in conversation with Albert, mentioned casually that Werther would not return before Christmas Eve; and soon afterward Albert went on horseback to see a person in the neighbourhood, with whom he had to transact some business which would detain him all night.

translation.en: She had mentioned casually to Albert that Werther would not come back before Christmas Eve.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 베르테르가 성탄 전야 전에는 오지 않을 것이라고 알베르트에게 지나가듯 말해 두었다.

translation.en: Soon afterwards Albert rode off to see a man in the neighbourhood, on business that would keep him away all night.
translation.kr: 얼마 뒤 알베르트는 밤새 걸릴 볼일로 이웃 마을 사람을 만나러 말을 타고 떠났다.

raw: Charlotte was sitting alone. None of her family were near, and she gave herself up to the reflections that silently took possession of her mind. She was for ever united to a husband whose love and fidelity she had proved, to whom she was heartily devoted, and who seemed to be a special gift from Heaven to ensure her happiness. On the other hand, Werther had become dear to her. There was a cordial unanimity of sentiment between them from the very first hour of their acquaintance, and their long association and repeated interviews had made an indelible impression upon her heart. She had been accustomed to communicate to him every thought and feeling which interested her, and his absence threatened to open a void in her existence which it might be impossible to fill. How heartily she wished that she might change him into her brother,—that she could induce him to marry one of her own friends, or could reestablish his intimacy with Albert.

translation.en: Charlotte was sitting alone.
translation.kr: 샤를로테는 혼자 앉아 있었다.

translation.en: None of her family were near her, and she gave herself up to the thoughts that quietly took possession of her mind.
translation.kr: 식구 가운데 아무도 곁에 없었고, 그 사람은 조용히 마음을 차지해 오는 생각들에 자신을 내맡겼다.

translation.en: She was united for ever to a husband whose love and fidelity she had proved, to whom she was heartily devoted, and who seemed a special gift from Heaven to secure her happiness.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 사랑과 신의를 이미 확인한 남편, 온 마음으로 따르는 남편, 제 행복을 지켜 주라고 하늘이 특별히 보내 준 듯한 남편과 영원히 맺어져 있었다.

translation.en: On the other hand, Werther had become dear to her.
translation.kr: 한편으로 베르테르는 그 사람에게 소중한 사람이 되어 있었다.

translation.en: There had been a warm unanimity of feeling between them from the very first hour of their acquaintance, and their long association and repeated meetings had made an indelible impression on her heart.
translation.kr: 알게 된 첫 순간부터 둘 사이에는 따뜻한 감정의 일치가 있었고, 오랜 사귐과 거듭된 만남이 그 마음에 지울 수 없는 자국을 남겨 놓았다.

translation.en: She had grown used to sharing with him every thought and feeling that interested her, and his absence threatened to open a void in her life that might be impossible to fill.
translation.kr: 마음을 끄는 생각과 느낌이라면 무엇이든 그와 나누는 데 익숙해져 있었으니, 그가 사라지면 메울 수 없을지도 모를 빈자리가 삶에 생길 판이었다.

translation.en: How heartily she wished she could turn him into a brother, or persuade him to marry one of her own friends, or re-establish his old intimacy with Albert.
translation.kr: 그를 오라비로 바꾸어 놓을 수 있다면, 또는 제 벗 가운데 하나와 혼인하게 할 수 있다면, 또는 알베르트와 옛 우정을 되살리게 할 수 있다면 얼마나 좋을까 하고 그 사람은 간절히 바랐다.

raw: She passed all her intimate friends in review before her mind, but found something objectionable in each, and could decide upon none to whom she would consent to give him.

translation.en: She passed all her close friends in review before her mind, but found something objectionable in each, and could settle on none she would be willing to give him to.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 가까운 벗들을 하나하나 마음속에 떠올려 보았으나, 저마다 마뜩잖은 구석이 있어 그를 맡길 만한 사람을 하나도 정하지 못했다.

raw: Amid all these considerations she felt deeply but indistinctly that her own real but unexpressed wish was to retain him for herself, and her pure and amiable heart felt from this thought a sense of oppression which seemed to forbid a prospect of happiness. She was wretched: a dark cloud obscured her mental vision.

translation.en: Through all these considerations she felt deeply, though indistinctly, that her own real but unspoken wish was to keep him for herself.
translation.kr: 이 모든 생각을 거치는 동안, 그 사람은 어렴풋하게나마 깊이 느꼈다. 입 밖에 내지 못한 제 진짜 바람은 그를 자기 곁에 두는 것이라는 것을.

translation.en: And her pure and amiable heart felt an oppression at that thought which seemed to shut out any prospect of happiness.
translation.kr: 그리고 그 맑고 고운 마음은 그 생각에 짓눌려, 어떤 행복의 앞날도 닫혀 버리는 것만 같았다.

translation.en: She was wretched: a dark cloud had come over her mind.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 비참했다. 어두운 구름이 마음을 덮고 있었다.

raw: It was now half-past six o'clock, and she heard Werther's step on the stairs. She at once recognised his voice, as he inquired if she were at home. Her heart beat audibly—we could almost say for the first time—at his arrival. It was too late to deny herself; and, as he entered, she exclaimed, with a sort of ill concealed confusion, "You have not kept your word!" "I promised nothing," he answered. "But you should have complied, at least for my sake," she continued. "I implore you, for both our sakes."

translation.en: It was now half-past six, and she heard Werther's step on the stairs.
translation.kr: 여섯 시 반이 되었을 때, 층계에서 베르테르의 발소리가 들렸다.

translation.en: She knew his voice at once, asking whether she was at home.
translation.kr: 집에 있느냐고 묻는 그 목소리를 그 사람은 곧바로 알아들었다.

translation.en: Her heart beat audibly — we could almost say for the first time — at his coming.
translation.kr: 그가 왔다는 것에 그 사람의 심장이 소리가 나도록 뛰었다 — 거의 처음 있는 일이었다고 해도 좋으리라.

translation.en: It was too late to deny herself; and as he came in she exclaimed, with a kind of ill-concealed confusion, "You have not kept your word!"
translation.kr: 이제 없다고 하기에는 늦었다. 그가 들어서자 그 사람은 감추지 못한 당황함으로 외쳤다. "약속을 지키지 않으셨군요!"

translation.en: "I promised nothing," he answered.
translation.kr: "나는 아무 약속도 하지 않았습니다." 그가 답했다.

translation.en: "But you should have done as I asked, at least for my sake," she went on.
translation.kr: "그래도 제 청을 들어주셨어야지요. 저를 보아서라도요." 그 사람이 말을 이었다.

translation.en: "I implore you, for both our sakes."
translation.kr: "부탁드립니다. 우리 두 사람을 위해서요."

raw: She scarcely knew what she said or did; and sent for some friends, who, by their presence, might prevent her being left alone with Werther. He put down some books he had brought with him, then made inquiries about some others, until she began to hope that her friends might arrive shortly, entertaining at the same time a desire that they might stay away.

translation.en: She scarcely knew what she was saying or doing, and sent for some friends whose presence might keep her from being left alone with Werther.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 제가 무슨 말을 하고 무엇을 하는지도 모르는 채, 베르테르와 단둘이 남지 않도록 벗 몇을 불러오게 했다.

translation.en: He put down some books he had brought, then asked about some others, until she began to hope her friends would arrive soon — while at the same time wishing they would stay away.
translation.kr: 그는 가져온 책들을 내려놓고 다른 책에 대해 물었고, 그러는 사이 그 사람은 벗들이 곧 오기를 바라면서도 한편으로는 오지 않기를 바라고 있었다.

raw: At one moment she felt anxious that the servant should remain in the adjoining room, then she changed her mind. Werther, meanwhile, walked impatiently up and down. She went to the piano, and determined not to retire. She then collected her thoughts, and sat down quietly at Werther's side, who had taken his usual place on the sofa.

translation.en: At one moment she wanted the servant to stay in the next room; then she changed her mind.
translation.kr: 한순간 그 사람은 하인이 옆방에 있어 주기를 바랐다가, 곧 마음을 바꾸었다.

translation.en: Werther meanwhile walked impatiently up and down.
translation.kr: 그동안 베르테르는 초조하게 방 안을 오갔다.

translation.en: She went to the piano, and resolved not to withdraw.
translation.kr: 그 사람은 피아노 앞으로 가서, 물러나지 않겠다고 마음먹었다.

translation.en: Then she collected herself and sat down quietly at Werther's side, where he had taken his usual place on the sofa.
translation.kr: 그러고는 마음을 가다듬고, 여느 때처럼 소파에 자리를 잡은 베르테르 곁에 조용히 앉았다.

raw: "Have you brought nothing to read?" she inquired. He had nothing. "There in my drawer," she continued, "you will find your own translation of some of the songs of Ossian. I have not yet read them, as I have still hoped to hear you recite them; but, for some time past, I have not been able to accomplish such a wish." He smiled, and went for the manuscript, which he took with a shudder. He sat down; and, with eyes full of tears, he began to read.

translation.en: "Have you brought nothing to read?" she asked.
translation.kr: "읽을 것을 가져오지 않으셨어요?" 그 사람이 물었다.

translation.en: He had nothing.
translation.kr: 그는 아무것도 가져오지 않았다.

translation.en: "There in my drawer," she went on, "you will find your own translation of some of the songs of Ossian."
translation.kr: "저기 서랍에" 하고 그 사람이 말을 이었다. "당신이 옮기신 오시안의 노래가 몇 편 들어 있어요."

translation.en: "I have not read them yet, as I kept hoping to hear you recite them; but for some time now there has been no chance of it."
translation.kr: "아직 읽지 않았어요. 당신 목소리로 듣고 싶어 기다렸는데, 한동안 그럴 기회가 없었네요."

translation.en: He smiled, and went for the manuscript, which he took up with a shudder.
translation.kr: 그는 웃으며 원고를 가지러 갔고, 그것을 집어 들 때 몸을 떨었다.

translation.en: He sat down, and with his eyes full of tears, he began to read.
translation.kr: 그는 자리에 앉아, 눈에 눈물을 가득 담은 채 읽기 시작했다.
